notes: MOVENTO 760H/766H and TANDEM 560H runners for wooden drawers, from the Blum Catalogue and technical manual 2024/2025, printed pages 412-413 and 434-435 (order information and planning). Inside drawer width SKW = LW - 42 (+0/-1.5), drawer length SKL = NL - 10, inside depth at least NL + 3. base_above_datum_min is the 'min 27.5' / 'min 28.5' from the surface the runner stands on to the underside of the drawer base; base_recess is the 12-15 mm the sides reach below the base. The runner attachment positions (pp. 428, 460) are not recorded yet: which hole takes the system screw is hard to read reliably. The 766H rows are '60 | 70 kg' on p.412 without a clear split, so they carry no load. Not verified by a person.
